parallels.note: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

people.name: Etham
people.line: Wilderness area where Israelites camped during the Exodus

people.name: Marah
people.line: A place with bitter water on the Exodus route

people.name: Pi-hahiroth
people.line: A place near the Red Sea crossing

translations.web: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
translations.bsb: They set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea, into the wilderness, and they journeyed three days into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
translations.kjv: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness: and they went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
